title: mojolearn: bitwise-identical GPU machine learning in Mojo on Apple Metal, NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP
description:
mojolearn is a GPU machine-learning library written in Mojo whose opt-in identical numeric mode makes supported inference and training return the same bits on Apple Metal, NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP. One Mojo source implements a shared numerical profile across the three backends: fixed reductions, portable arithmetic and explicit refusal of unsupported configurations. The claim is established by stage-level identity cards and separating sabotage tests, never inferred from a final-output hash, and applies only to configurations recorded in SUPPORT_MATRIX.md.

The contract covers Mamba and transformer inference and fixed-shape training (a byte-level language model trained on real text reproduces its parameters, gradients, optimizer state and checkpoint bytes on all three vendors, with checkpoint continuation between NVIDIA and AMD), gradient-boosted and randomized trees, classical estimators and UMAP. The classical side ports the GPU kernels of CatBoost, cuML, cuVS, RAFT and FAISS into one Mojo source under a copy-do-not-improve rule, so GPU tree training and classical learning also run on Apple silicon, which the originals do not reach. Two further modes ship beside identical: fast (throughput, bits may move run to run) and deterministic (same bits on repeated runs of one device). Bitwise identity has a cost: identical mode is competitive on some tree workloads and substantially slower on many classical, matrix and neural workloads against cuML, cuBLAS and PyTorch; the measurements and certificates are in the repository's bench/results and in the accompanying paper.
